meta.description: AC2.3 fixture prompts for the Requirements agent. 'today' anchors relative dates. Only listed expected fields are checked; interests are checked as a subset.

cases.prompt: We're a family of 4 (kids aged 6 and 9) visiting Dubai from 10 to 14 February 2027. Budget is AED 12,000 total. We're vegetarian and love history and the beach.
My wife and I want 5 days in March 2027, budget around $3,000. We like food and shopping.
Solo trip, 2027-01-20 to 2027-01-23, AED 4500, halal food only, interested in architecture and views.
Three friends, 4 nights starting 5 April 2027, AED 15000 for the whole group, we want desert adventure and nightlife.
2 adults, December 18-21 2026, 7000 dirhams. One of us is vegan and gluten-free. Art and culture please.
I'm travelling with my husband, 3 days from 8 Jan 2027, budget AED 6000. He uses a wheelchair. Relaxed pace, museums and views.
2 adults and 3 kids, 6 days in April 2027, AED 20k, we want theme parks and the beach.
Couple, 15-18 July 2027, budget AED 8,000, we like shopping and views, halal.
4 adults, 1-4 March 2027, AED 3000 per person, food lovers and history buffs.
